candidate.name: Workshop OS 12.2.0 Sign-in Code Key
candidate.purpose: A second device-issued key, separate from the read-only status token, whose only route is GET /api/portal-code: it returns the current Local Portal sign-in code and a per-boot id so Local AI can show the code. Created after Allow on the touchscreen, stored as SHA-256 only, rate-limited and tied to the sign-in lock-out. Whoever holds the key can sign in. On top of 12.1.4 (main).

mainState.name: Workshop OS 12.1.4 More Overhaul
mainState.note: Exact CI candidate 2e7e8c331f4333715980c05b8314b84bc9afb15f (PR #170 head) was installed on the WS350 and is running with candidatePending false; the owner reviewed it on the device and approved the merge. main 6c86a72 has a source tree identical to 2e7e8c3; its CI image differs only in the embedded source SHA and the image checksum. The unattended acceptance script, sensory physical acceptance and a full-image recovery round-trip have not been run for 12.1.x, so physical acceptance stays pending and nothing is promoted.
